title: Uniform spanning tree of the square-sum graph
plain: Show a uniformly random spanning tree of the square-sum graph has diameter of order a fixed power of N, and find the exponent.
math: For $T$ a uniform spanning tree of the giant component of $S_N$, prove $\mathrm{diam}(T)=N^{\alpha+o(1)}$ in probability and determine $\alpha$.
